environment.description: AWS Lambda function accessed exclusively through an internal Application Load Balancer (scheme: internal) in VPC subnet 10.200.0.0/24. The ALB has a listener rule on port 443 with a fixed-response action (403) as the default rule. A forward-to-target-group rule is conditioned on source-ip matching a managed prefix list (pl-0a8b2c3d4e5f) that resolves to three internal CIDR blocks: 10.50.12.0/24 (CI/CD runners), 10.50.13.0/28 (admin workstations), and 172.16.200.0/23 (partner VPN egress). The VPC has no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, and the ALB security group (sg-0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8) ingress rules reference only the same prefix list on port 443. VPC Flow Logs are enabled with REJECT logging. The Lambda is invoked only via ALB integration (no function URL, no API Gateway). Route tables for the ALB subnets have no 0.0.0.0/0 route.
